card.name: Carbamazepine epoxide and scattered odd spots
card.fires_on: Small tokens in and around carbamazepine metabolite names (the space before 10,11-epoxide, 'and', '(') and the first digit of a refrigeration range like 36°F to 46°F. Also seen on isolated words such as 'Prof.' or 'by' in unrelated web text.
